description: Unit tests check small pieces of code. We will practise using simple JavaScript functions and explicit checks before moving to a separate test runner. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain boundary cases in a unit
learningObjectives: Practise fresh data for each test

seo.title: Unit Testing Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Unit Testing with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
